paras: Near Kharanos, Elder Goldwell appears during the Lunar Festival. The ancient earthen spirit recalls the origins of modern dwarven civilization.

Elder Goldwell watches over the snowy slopes near Kharanos as a translucent earthen spirit. His stony form recalls the Titan-forged ancestors from whom the Bronzebeard clan descended. During the ancestor celebrations, travelers can honor that heritage in his presence.
